# Licking Cream

| producer   =
*Toby Wright
*Sevendust
}}
"Licking Cream" is a promotional single by American rock band Sevendust from their second album Home. The song is the first single from Sevendust that was released in Europe. The song features additional vocals by singer Skin of the band Skunk Anansie.
Music video
The song music video directed by Ben Joe Dempsey. The video was made depicting the band playing in a dilapidated apartment building in Germany.
